results.content:
## By The Numbers

The latest Harvard/Harris survey found 41 percent of registered voters aged 18 to 24 approved of Trump's job performance, while 54 percent disapproved, leaving him underwater by 13 points.

That poll was conducted online by The Harris Poll and HarrisX from September 26 to 28 among 2,200 registered voters. Its full-sample margin of error was plus or minus 2.1 percentage points at the 95 percent confidence level.
